_comment: Seed conversations for the support-desk agent, loaded by `python -m src.seed` with short_term.add_message() (GLiNER2.5 extraction on, against the active support-desk ontology). Conversation 1 is the transcript of examples/ontology-lifecycle-bolt, string for string. The others overlap on purpose so entity resolution has work to do: Marcus Bell and Elena Fischer return in later conversations (exact merges), 'Priya' and 'Elena' are first-name-only mentions (pending review pairs), 'the Halcyon Chair' is a shorter name for the Halcyon Ergonomic Chair, and TK-2210, TK-2211, TK-2214 and TK-2217 are referenced again from later conversations.

conversations.title: Priya Raman: cracked Aurora Desk Lamp

messages.content: Hi, this is Priya Raman. Order SO-4417 arrived yesterday and the Aurora Desk Lamp was cracked.
Sorry about that, Priya. I've opened ticket TK-2210 for order SO-4417 covering the damaged Aurora Desk Lamp.
Can you send a replacement lamp rather than a refund?
Done — ticket TK-2210 is now a replacement request for the Aurora Desk Lamp, shipping to the address on order SO-4417.
Also, the Northwind Cable Tray from order SO-4390 was the wrong colour. Same ticket or a new one?
I've opened ticket TK-2211 for the Northwind Cable Tray on order SO-4390 so the two shipments stay separate.

conversations.title: Marcus Bell: Halcyon chair delivery is late

messages.content: Hello, my name is Marcus Bell. I ordered the Halcyon Ergonomic Chair on order SO-4452 two weeks ago and it still hasn't arrived.
Thanks for your patience, Marcus Bell. Order SO-4452 is held at the carrier's depot, so I've opened ticket TK-2214 to chase delivery of the Halcyon Ergonomic Chair.
Please let me know when it moves. I need the chair before Monday.
Ticket TK-2214 is marked urgent, and we'll email you the moment order SO-4452 is back in transit.

conversations.title: Elena Fischer: monitor arm missing bolts

messages.content: Hi, Elena Fischer here. The Lumen Monitor Arm from order SO-4468 came without its mounting bolts.
Apologies, Elena. I've opened ticket TK-2217 for the missing bolts on the Lumen Monitor Arm from order SO-4468.
Will you ship just the bolts, or the whole arm again?
Only the missing parts: ticket TK-2217 covers a parts shipment for the Lumen Monitor Arm, so you keep the arm you already have.

conversations.title: Daniel Okafor: standing desk motor failed

messages.content: This is Daniel Okafor. The motor in my Breeze Standing Desk stopped working after a week. It was order SO-4471.
I'm sorry to hear that, Daniel Okafor. I've opened ticket TK-2219 for the faulty motor on the Breeze Standing Desk from order SO-4471.
I'd rather have a refund than a repair.
Understood. Ticket TK-2219 is now a refund request for order SO-4471, and a return label for the Breeze Standing Desk is on its way.

conversations.title: Marcus Bell: chair arrived, adding to an open order

messages.content: Marcus Bell again. The Halcyon Chair from order SO-4452 finally arrived, so you can close ticket TK-2214.
Great news, Marcus Bell. Ticket TK-2214 is closed now that order SO-4452 has been delivered.
While I have you, can I add a Tidewater Desk Organizer to my open order SO-4489?
Order SO-4489 hasn't shipped yet, so I've added the Tidewater Desk Organizer to it.

conversations.title: Grace Liu: charged twice for one lamp

messages.content: Hi, I'm Grace Liu. I was charged twice for order SO-4503, which was a single Aurora Desk Lamp.
I can see the duplicate charge on order SO-4503, Grace Liu. I've opened ticket TK-2223 with billing to refund the second payment.
How long will the refund take?
Billing usually settles tickets like TK-2223 within three business days, and the refund goes back to the card used for order SO-4503.

conversations.title: Priya Raman: where is the replacement lamp?

messages.content: Hello again, Priya Raman here. Ticket TK-2210 said a replacement Aurora Desk Lamp would ship, but order SO-4417 still shows no tracking.
Thanks for checking in, Priya Raman. The replacement Aurora Desk Lamp for ticket TK-2210 left the warehouse this morning, and tracking for order SO-4417 will update tonight.
And what about the Northwind Cable Tray on ticket TK-2211?
Ticket TK-2211 is approved: a Northwind Cable Tray in the right colour ships with the same courier as the lamp.

conversations.title: Elena Fischer: new standing desk wobbles

messages.content: Elena Fischer again. The parts sent for ticket TK-2217 fixed my Lumen Monitor Arm, but the Breeze Standing Desk from order SO-4510 wobbles at full height.
Glad that's sorted, Elena Fischer. I've opened ticket TK-2226 because the Breeze Standing Desk on order SO-4510 wobbles.
Is that the same motor problem another customer had?
No, ticket TK-2226 is a stability issue with the frame, not the motor fault an earlier batch of the Breeze Standing Desk had.
